question: Does source-reviewed safe compaction improve original completion and actual products once the fallible generator/checker is removed from candidate admission?
preceding_turn: Progress: host-constructed pairs reached the checker, which produced safe but subthreshold edits and at least two explicit schema-enum false vetoes. This did not test actor efficacy.
evidence_chain: Original 283 failures repeatedly exhausted rounds or response tokens without complete truthful delivery; fewer calls and local interface fixes did not establish dual improvement. Those stop fields identify truncation, not its cause.
Changed tool descriptions occupy 5497/52816 Middle and 10292/62332 Late model-tool JSON characters. These are characters, not tokens, and size is not established as the dominant cause.

Direct deletion generation was empty on real metadata and unsafe on elementary controls. Relation generation then failed reference location. Same-field joining finally reached gap checking but gave 323/366-character edits and source-contradicting vetoes.

Independent source adjudication, documented line by line, identifies a different deterministic policy: 9 Middle deletions/546 characters and 15 Late deletions/976 characters. All schemas, examples, unique conditions and cited witnesses remain. No previous candidate is relabeled or manually repaired in place.
mechanism: Exact, researcher-authored source coverage certificates replace stochastic edit proposal and semantic admission. The runtime updater is deterministic: require the frozen policy digest and every affected full native contract hash, require all affected hosts to have changed, verify source witnesses survive, and delete only the listed lines. Unknown contracts fail closed. No actor-time controller, extra calls or replacement prose.

coverage_review.parameter_fields: Preserve semantic description, type and enum in their complete property schemas. Explicit current-path context is cited for convergenceDetected. Clear paraphrases of the same decision/relation are accepted; unique end conditions, optionality/branch conditions, sequence qualifiers, examples and ambiguous conclusions remain.
coverage_review.same_description: Retain the later exact permission to question/revise thoughts, removing the redundant permission. Retain the explicit instruction to develop each path with its own independent reasoning chain, removing the repeated per-path chain statement.
coverage_review.limits: This is a source-reviewed policy for known contracts, not a formal natural-language entailment theorem or an automatic general updater. The same coordinator authored and reviewed it; semantic assumptions are visible. No benchmark question/answer/scored trajectory is encoded in the policy.

EasyTool.borrow: Prepared compact tool instructions preserving functional information. Author code consumes prepared instructions; our exact deletion table is not its staged tool/API/argument executor or full method.

literature_and_code.Self_Refine_and_CoVe: The prior frozen feedback-based versions borrowed missing-content review and separated verification contexts; their pins remain in results/evidence/verified-coverage-20261101/research-decision.json. This round deliberately removes their online feedback step to test the downstream value of a source-reviewed patch. It does not claim to reproduce either method.
literature_and_code.research_distinction: Candidate knowledge and generation mechanism differ from parameter_coverage v1. Its closed result and frozen size gate remain unchanged. This deterministic policy retains that same 500-character per-stage gate and all original product/performance gates.

candidate_comparison.minimum: Freeze exact source-reviewed candidate and 10 original SP-controlled cells. This directly tests end-to-end value instead of another generator-only cycle.

candidate_comparison.reason: Would continue confounding successful generation with actor efficacy; observed mistakes have not shown that compaction is worthwhile.
Might address persistent execution failures but changes explicitly frozen actor conditions; out of scope, not a prerequisite for this legal trial.

authority.course: Preserve NU/FR and original benchmark provenance, TF/PE/ECS/recovery/retention/cost reporting and reproducibility. Course report already delivered; user ended presentation and cancelled further slides/scripts.
authority.user: Original full changed subset dual improvement and two separately passing independent validation blocks, complete actual products, no task/answer/scored-trajectory updater inputs, main-only writer/executor, same branch, no push.
authority.fairness: Same fixed actor/judge model/provider/decoding/budgets/tools/scoring; original 133M/L+283M/L and 235L retention; original SP concurrent control. All original outcomes preserved. No total budget newly imposed.
authority.implementation: Source-reviewed deterministic policies are allowed by existing contract_reconcile/ready_link precedents; a paid LLM updater is not mandatory. This uses no replacement updater model. Full contract hashes and 500-character manipulation gate are this version's safeguards, not universal research prohibitions.

review_integration: Reuse completed independent review: mechanisms, scope and validation matter beyond phrasing; no universal positive-actor prerequisite; source citations alone are not semantic truth. All semantic adjudications and known-contract limits are explicitly disclosed, and original product checks remain decisive.
competing_explanations: Safe reduction is only about 1–2 percent of the total model-tool JSON characters; dynamic planning and output construction may dominate. An original failure would reject this specific magnitude/policy, not prove all compression ineffective.
Repeated documentation can help salience. Removing true redundancy may still harm tool use or product construction.
Any gain combines length and emphasis changes. This two-arm trial does not identify a pure token-length effect or prove automated updater generalization.
133 and 235 knowledge remain byte-identical across arms. Their observed differences cannot establish an adaptation effect; the separate strict 283 gate remains mandatory.
decision_rule: All original project and whole-changed strict completion/core gains, TF nondecrease and retention nondecrease must pass. Otherwise close this version, retain all outputs, do not resample. If development passes, run both fresh 30-cell validation blocks with unchanged knowledge; each must independently pass. Same exposed tasks, not unseen families.
cost_and_effort: Zero updater API calls; researcher policy authoring/review is disclosed and not represented as automated learning cost. Original dev estimate USD 0.10–0.40, not a cap. Independent null-cap ledgers for development and each validation block.
